description: This file is a Perl module implementing the Git::SVN package, which provides an interface for interacting with SVN repositories within a Git context. It includes functions for remote repository configuration, revision mapping, fetching, revision analysis, and utility methods for working with SVN and Git integration details.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: This class provides methods for interacting with SVN repositories within Git, including configuration, revision mapping, repository info, and utility functions for repository navigation and data extraction.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves reference glob patterns to local ref names, updating the fetch map accordingly.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments provided to specify revision ranges like base and head revisions.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all SVN revisions within the specified remote remotes, updating internal revision maps.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads all remote repository configurations from git config and returns a structured hash.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new Git::SVN object with specified URL and path, optionally setting remote configuration.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Finds and returns a Git::SVN object corresponding to a given SVN URL, optionally matching specific repository root and path.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves or caches the UUID of the SVN repository for the current remote.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Returns the repository root URL, fetching from config or setting if necessary.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL of the current repository, including path.

methods.name: full_pushurl
methods.description: Constructs the full push URL if configured, otherwise returns the full URL.

methods.name: set_commit_header_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for commit author and date based on SVN log entry data.

methods.name: restore_commit_header_env
methods.description: Restores environment variables after a commit, to previous state.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Validates and fetches author information, possibly invoking an external program for author lookups.

methods.name: find_extra_svk_parents
methods.description: Finds additional parent revisions based on Svk-specific merge properties.

methods.name: lookup_svn_merge
methods.description: Determines merge info and revisions involved in an SVN merge, returning relevant commit ranges.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Constructs a detailed log entry for a specific revision, including metadata, parents, author, date, and merge info.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs fetch operation on SVN revisions within a specified range.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Sets theGit tree for the current commit, creating a new commit if necessary.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds internal revision mappings from the repository, used for synchronization and consistency.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Sets the Git tree for the current commit, creating a new commit if necessary.
